svg.title: The delivery pipeline
svg.desc: Work branches from integration, passes the local gates and a pull request’s checks, and is squash-merged; the push runs deploy-staging, which builds the API functions and the web at that commit, aliases the staging site and verifies it. A release is a merge-commit pull request from integration to main; deploy-production waits for every required check plus playwright on the exact commit, deploys the API and verifies it by commit, builds the web unaliased and smokes it, promotes it with a public smoke and a rollback edge, then tags vX.Y.Z. The app re-archives at the tag so web, API and App Store share one version. Afterwards the data canary and uptime keep watching.
